strings.STR_ACE_Dogtags_IGUI_Description: Onscreen display for checking Dog Tags
strings.STR_ACE_Dogtags_dogtagAlreadyTaken: Somebody else has already taken the Dog Tag...
strings.STR_ACE_Dragging_DragAndFire_Description: Allow the player to fire their gun while dragging.
strings.STR_ACE_Dragging_allowRunWithLightweight: Allow the player to run when carrying lightweight objects.
strings.STR_ACE_Dragging_skipContainerWeight_Des: Determines whether object's weight is added onto weight calculations.
strings.STR_ACE_Dragging_weightCoefficient_Descr: Modifies weight limit calculations. Set to 0 to ignore.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_DistanceToFar: Distance to %1 has become too far for treatment
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_FractureChance_Descripti: The probability of a fracture causing wound resulting in a fracture.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Fractures_Description: Controls the effect of using splints to treat fractures.\nWhen disabled, injuries will not cause fractures.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Limping_Description: Controls whether open or bandaged wounds cause a person to limp.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Limping_LimpRequiresStit: Limp on Open or Bandaged Wounds
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_MedicalSettings_enableFo: Select what units the advanced medical system will be enabled for
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_MedicalSettings_enableVe: Do units take damage from a vehicle crash?
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_SpontaneousWakeUpChance_: The probability that a person with stable vitals will wake up from unconsciousness (checked every 15 seconds).
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_blockInputOnUiEvent_Desc: Prevent accidental firing after medical menu unexpectedly closes or waking up
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_blockInputOnUiEvent_Disp: Block mouse input after unexpected UI change
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_spontaneousWakeUpEpineph: When an unconscious patient has Epinephrine in their system, the time between spontaneous wake up checks is divided by this value.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_AI_enableFor_desc: AI will respond to injury and unconsciousness
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_AI_requireItems_desc: AI will only perform medical treatment if they have the necessary items in their inventory.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_AIDamageThreshold: Sets the amount of damage an AI unit can receive before going unconscious (or dying when "Sum of Trauma" is enabled).
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_AlternateArmorPen: Controls whether ammo material penetration is taken into account for damage handling.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_DeathChance_Descr: The chance of dying to a fatal injury.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_Eden_threshold_De: Sets the amount of damage a unit can receive before going unconscious. (0 for mission default)
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_PainUnconsciousCh: The probability of a person falling unconscious when their pain is above the tolerance threshold upon receiving damage.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_PainUnconsciousTh: Sets the threshold for severe pain, above which a person can fall unconscious upon receiving damage.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_PlayerDamageThres: Sets the amount of damage a player can receive before going unconscious (and dying if "Sum of Trauma" is enabled).
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_fatalDamageSource: Determines what damage can be fatal
Only large hits to vital organs
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_limbDamageThresho: Sets the amount of damage limbs can receive before going critical, leading to death. Must be over 0 for any effect.\nRequires the "Use Limb Damage" setting to be enabled and "Fatal Damage Source" to be set to "Sum of Trauma" or "Either".\nStacks multiplicatively with the overall unit Damage Threshold. Doesn't interact with fractures/limping at all.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Damage_uselimbDamage_Des: Controls whether limb damage is taken into account for sum of trauma calculations.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Engine_EnableVehicleCras: Controls whether crew receives damage from vehicle collisions.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Feedback_EnableHUDIndica: Enables indicators for fractures and applied tourniquets and splints over the Stance Indicator.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Feedback_BloodVolumeEffe: Selects the used low blood volume effect type.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Feedback_PainEffectType_: Selects the used pain effect type.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_BloodLossColor_Descr: Defines the 10 color gradient used to indicate blood loss in Medical GUIs.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_DamageColor_Descript: Defines the 10 color gradient used to indicate damage in Medical GUIs.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_EnableActions_Descri: Enables medical actions for the Interaction Menu and selects their style.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_EnableMedicalMenu_De: Enables the use of the Medical Menu through the keybind or interaction menu.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_EnableSelfActions_De: Enables medical actions for the Self Interaction Menu.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_InteractionMenuShowT: Shows the patient's triage level by changing the color of the main and medical menu actions.
Show Triage Level in Interaction Menu
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_Lost_Blood3: Lost a large amount of blood
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_Lost_Blood4: Lost a fatal amount of blood
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_MaxDistance_Descript: Maximum distance from which the Medical Menu can be opened.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_OpenAfterTreatment_D: Reopen the Medical Menu after successful treatment.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_PARTIAL_BANDAGED_WOU: There is a partial %1 Bandaged wound
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_PARTIAL_OPEN_WOUND: There is a partial %1 Open wound
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_PeekMedicalInfoRelea: How long the medical info peek remains open after releasing the key.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_PeekMedicalOnHitDura: How long the medical info peek remains open after being injured.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_PeekMedicalOnHit_Des: Temporarily show medical info when injured.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_ShowBloodlossEntry_D: Show qualitative blood loss in the injury list.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_TourniquetWarning_De: Show a warning tooltip when a tourniquet will interfere with a medical action.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_bodyPartOutlineColor: Color of outline around selected body part.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_medicalHintEnabled_D: If enabled, patients will have a customizable message displayed when a player opens their medical menu.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_medicalHintMedicIcon: Image path to display in the medical hint if the player is a medic.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_medicalHintMessage_D: Custom message to display to patients when opening their medical menu.\n%1 will be your name.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_needToHolster: You must holster your weapon first!
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_showBleeding_Descrip: Display if the patient is bleeding, optionally with rate
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_GUI_showDamageEntry_Desc: Show trauma sustained in the injury list.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Statemachine_AIUnconscio:
Controls whether AI can go unconscious instead of immediately dying.
This setting works together with the "AI Fatal Injuries" setting since, going into cardiac arrest requires that the unit is able to go unconscious.
However, these settings are separated because units can go unconscious from critical vitals resulting from non-fatal injuries.
In essence, this means that in order to enable cardiac arrest for AI units, this setting must be enabled.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Statemachine_CardiacArre: Controls whether a person can die in cardiac arrest by blood loss before the cardiac arrest time runs out.
Controls how long it takes to die from cardiac arrest.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Statemachine_FatalInjuri: Controls when AI can receive fatal injuries. A fatal injury is caused by significant damage to the head or troso.\nWhen set to "Always", this effectively produces "AI Instant Death" behaviour as AI will immediately die from any fatal injury.\nNOTE: Any mode other than "Always" requires AI Unconsciousness to be enabled.
Controls when players can receive fatal injuries. A fatal injury is caused by significant damage to the head or torso.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Status_BleedingCoefficie: Coefficient for controlling the bleeding speed.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Status_DropWeaponUnconsc: Chance for a player to drop their weapon when going unconscious.\nHas no effect on AI.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Status_IvFlowRate_Descri: Controls how quickly fluid flows out of IV Bags. The IV Bag volume change is calculated as:\ntime interval (s) * iv change per second (4.1667 mL/s) * flow rate (this coefficient).
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Status_PainCoefficient_D: Coefficient for controlling the intensity of pain adjustments.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Status_WindowOnWakeUp_De: Action on the game's window when waking up
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Adenosine_Desc: Used to counter effects of Epinephrine
A drug used to counter the effects of Epinephrine
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AdvancedBandag: Enables treatment actions for different bandage types instead of the generic Bandage action.\nAdditionally, the reopening of bandaged wounds can also be enabled.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AdvancedDiagno: Enables the Check Pulse, Check Blood Pressure, and Check Response treatment actions instead of the generic Diagnose action.\nWhen disabled, the CPR action will only be shown when performing CPR is appropriate.\nThe actions this setting enables are needed to determine whether a person is unconscious or in cardiac arrest.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AdvancedMedica: Enables extended, more in-depth medication handling. Also, enables the use of Adenosine.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Aid_Kit_Desc_S: Includes various treatment kit needed for stitching or advanced treatment
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Aid_Kit_Desc_U: Personal Aid Kit for in field stitching or advanced treatment
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowBodyBagUn: Enables placing an unconscious patient in a body bag.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowBodyBalli: Enables get-well wishes for people that aren't feeling too well.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowGraveDigg: Enables digging graves to dispose of corpses.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowLitterCre: Enables the creation of litter upon treatment.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowSelfIV_De: Enables the use of IV transfusions on oneself.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowSelfPAK_D: Enables the use of PAKs to heal oneself.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowSelfStitc: Enables the use of surgical kits to stitch oneself.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AllowSharedEqu: Controls whether medical equipment can be shared between the patient and the medic.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AssignMedicRol: This module allows you to assign the medic class to selected units.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_AssignMedicalF: Registers an object as a medical facility
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Atropine_Desc_: A drug used by the Military in NBC scenarios.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Attributes_isM: Whether or not the object will be a medical vehicle.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Bandage_Basic_: A dressing, that is a particular material used to cover a wound, which is applied over the wound once bleeding has been stemmed.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Bandage_Elasti: Allows an even compression and extra support to the injured area.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Blood_IV_Desc_: Blood IV, for restoring a patients blood
O Negative infusion blood used in strict and rare events to replenish blood supply usually conducted in the transport phase of medical care.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_CPRSuccessChan: Maximum probability that performing CPR will restore heart rhythm.\nThis maximum value is used when the patient has at most "Lost some blood".\nAn interpolated probability is used when the patient's blood volume is between the minimum and maximum thresholds.

Minimum probability that performing CPR will restore heart rhythm.\nThis minimum value is used when the patient has at least "Lost a fatal amount of blood".\nAn interpolated probability is used when the patient's blood volume is between the minimum and maximum thresholds.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_CanNotLoad: This person (%1) is awake and cannot be loaded
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_CanNotLoadDead: This person (%1) is dead and cannot be loaded

%1 is not responsive, motionless and cold
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_ClearTrauma_De: Controls when hitpoint damage from wounds is healed.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_ConsumePAK_Des: Controls whether a PAK should be consumed after use.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_ConsumeSurgica: What should be consumed after use.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_ConvertItems_D: Controls whether vanilla medical items are converted to ACE Medical items, removed only, or ignored.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Epinephrine_De: Increase heart rate and counter effects given by allergic reactions

A drug that works on a sympathetic response to dilate the bronchi, increase heart rate and counter such effects given by allergic reactions (anaphylaxis). Used in sudden cardiac arrest scenarios with decreasing positive outcomes.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_GraveDiggingMa: Enables the creation of grave markers when digging graves.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_HolsterRequire: Controls whether weapons must be holstered / lowered in order to perform medical actions.\nExcept Exam options allow examination actions (checking pulse, blood pressure, response) at all times regardless of this setting.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LitterCleanupD: Controls the lifetime of litter objects, in seconds. -1 is forever.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationAdenos: Controls where Adenosine can be used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationEpinep: Controls where epinephrine can be used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationIV_Des: Controls where IV transfusions can be performed.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationMorphi: Controls where Morphine can be used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationPAK_De: Controls where a PAK can be used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationSplint: Controls where Splints can be used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationSurgic: Controls where a surgical kit can be used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_LocationsBoost: Boost medical training when in medical vehicles or facilities. Untrained becomes medic, medic becomes doctor.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MaxLitterObjec: Sets the maximum number of litter objects which can be spawned, excessive amounts can cause FPS lag.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicAdenosine: Training level required to use Adenosine.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicEpinephri: Training level required to use epinephrine.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicIV_Descri: Training level required to transfuse IVs.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicMorphine_: Training level required to use Morphine.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicPAK_Descr: Training level required to use a PAK.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicSplint_De: Training level required to use Splint.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_MedicSurgicalK: Training level required to use a surgical kit.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Morphine_Desc_: Used to combat moderate to severe pain experiences
An analgesic used to combat moderate to severe pain experiences.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_NumericalPulse: Makes Check Pulse action give a numerical value based on setting
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Packing_Bandag: Used to pack medium to large wounds and stem the bleeding
A bandage used to pack the wound to stem bleeding and facilitate wound healing. Packing a wound is an option in large polytrauma injuries.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_QuikClot_Desc_: Hemostatic bandage with coagulant that stops bleeding.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Saline_IV_Desc: Saline IV, for restoring a patients blood
A medical volume-replenishing agent introduced into the blood system through an IV infusion.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_SurgicalKit_De: Surgical Kit for in field advanced medical treatment
Surgical Kit for in field advanced medical treatment
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TimeCoefficien: Modifies how long a PAK takes to apply.\nThe treatment time is based on the total body part damage multiplied by this coefficient, with a minimum of 10 seconds.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_Tourniquet_Des: Slows down blood loss when bleeding
A constricting device used to compress venous and arterial circulation in effect inhibiting or slowing blood flow and therefore decreasing loss of blood.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeA: Time, in seconds, required to administer medication using an autoinjector.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeB: Time, in seconds, required to put a patient in a body bag.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeC: Time, in seconds, required to perform CPR on a patient.
Multiply all treatment times with this coefficient when in Zeus.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeG: Time, in seconds, required to dig a grave for a body.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeI: Time, in seconds, required to administer an IV bag.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeS: Time, in seconds, required to apply a splint.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TreatmentTimeT: Time, in seconds, required to apply/remove a tourniquet.
Time, in seconds, required for a unit exceeding required training level to administer medication using an autoinjector.
Time, in seconds, required for a unit exceeding required training level to administer an IV bag.
Time, in seconds, required for a unit exceeding required training level to apply a splint.
Time, in seconds, required for a unit exceeding required training level to apply or remove a tourniquet.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_TriageCard_NoE: No entries on this triage card.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_WoundReopenCha: Coefficient for controlling the wound reopening chance. The final reopening chance is determined by multiplying this value with the specific reopening chance for the wound type and bandage used.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_WoundStitchTim: Time, in seconds, required to stitch a single wound.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_bandageEffecti: Determines how effective bandages are at closing wounds.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_bandageRollove: If enabled, bandages can close different types of wounds on the same body part.\nBandaging multiple injuries will scale bandaging time accordingly.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_bodybagWhileSt: The body twitched and may not be dead!
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_lostBloodALot: He's lost a lot of blood
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_noTourniquetOn: There is no tourniquet on this body part!
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Treatment_painkillers_De: Over-the-counter analgesic used to combat light to moderate pain experiences.
Over-the-counter analgesic used to combat light to moderate pain experiences.
strings.STR_ACE_Medical_Vitals_simulateSpO2_Desc: Enables oxygen saturation simulation, providing variable heart rate and oxygen demand based on physical activity and altitude. Required for Airway Management.
